scripts.dev:all: bun run db:up && bun run db:migrate && (bun run dev & bun run dev:api & wait)
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:api
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend && bun run typecheck && cd ../backend && bun run typecheck
scripts.db:migrate: docker exec rendez-postgres psql -U rendez -d rendez -c 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;' >/dev/null && docker exec rendez-postgres psql -U rendez -d template1 -c 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;' >/dev/null && cd backend && bun run db:deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: docker exec rendez-postgres psql -U rendez -d template1 -c 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;' >/dev/null && cd backend && bun run db:migrate
